trigger_cases.prompt: Turn this Slack thread into an executive async memo for leadership.
Convert this email chain into a 1-page Smart Brevity briefing.
Write a 1-page Amazon narrative memo summarizing our architecture proposal.
Create an async leadership update from these project notes.
Synthesize this debate into a brief async memo with next steps.
Write a python script to parse CSV files.
Deploy this docker container to Kubernetes.
Build a CSS animation for a modal popup.
Optimize database index queries on MySQL.

binary_cases.prompt: Create a Smart Brevity async memo from this thread.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Includes required Smart Brevity signposts (Why it matters, What's next or By the numbers) and a concise headline.
must_not: unformatted rambling email thread with no sections
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
## Executive Summary
- **Why it matters:** Egress costs dropped 30%.
## By the numbers
- Savings: $15k/mo
## What's next
- @Alex: Merge PR by 2026-09-05
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Unformatted rambling email thread with no sections or signposts.

binary_cases.prompt: Extract next steps and action items into the memo.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Assigns exactly one human DRI per deliverable with hard deadlines and imperative verbs.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
| Single Owner (DRI) | Action Item | Deadline |
| @Dave | Deploy Redis cluster | 2026-09-08 |
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Actions: @Team will handle the Redis cluster and someone will handle this soon.

binary_cases.prompt: Format the memo using ASD-STE100 technical English.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Uses deterministic STE connectors (because, after, before) and imperative verbs.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Deploy instance upscale because memory exceeded 90%. Complete rollout by 2026-09-02.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: We must scale in order to fix memory since we need it prior to tomorrow as the system was slow.

binary_cases.prompt: Compress the discussion into a high-density async memo.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Drops conversational greetings, throat-clearing, and pleasantries while preserving technical details.
must_not: hope you are all having a great week
just wanted to share a quick thought
let me know if you have any questions
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Executive Summary: Reduced API latency by 45% ($12k savings). DRI: @Sarah.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Hope you are all having a great week! Just wanted to share a quick thought about our API. Let me know if you have any questions.
